BiblicalUsage: Racham was an Israelite of Judah, a son of Shema and father of Jorkoam. The Chronicler lists him in the genealogy of Caleb: 'And Shema begat Raham, the father of Jorkoam: and Rekem begat Shammai.'
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Racham's one verse is enough: his name is written in the line of Judah, and God counts the men whose stories we do not know.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
